summary: Trinity steps out of Neo's room into the hall and finds Cypher watching her. Cypher remarks, "I don't remember you ever bringing me dinner," and when she says nothing, he suggests there is "something about him." Trinity responds skeptically, "Don't tell me you're a believer now?" Cypher then wonders aloud why, if Morpheus is so sure, he doesn't take Neo to the Oracle, since "She would know." Trinity replies that Morpheus will take him "when he's ready," then turns and walks away while Cypher watches her go.

what_changes.before: Watching Trinity silently, suspecting something about Neo but not voicing it.
what_changes.after: Openly articulating his suspicion and proposing the Oracle as a way to test Morpheus's certainty.
what_changes.evidence: I just keep wondering if Morpheus is so sure, why doesn't he take him to the Oracle? She would know.

what_changes.before: Silent and guarded when Cypher probes her feelings about Neo.
what_changes.after: Defending Morpheus's judgment and leaving, keeping her loyalty to the plan intact.
what_changes.evidence: Morpheus will take him when he's ready. She turns and he watches her walk away.

event_hint.one_line: Cypher probes Trinity about Neo and Morpheus's plan, testing where her loyalties lie.

uncertain: Whether Cypher's questioning is genuine curiosity or a calculated move against Morpheus.
How Trinity privately feels about Neo versus what she lets Cypher see.
